mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: the result explained how seawater circulates through heated rock and carries dissolved chemicals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Checking the vent and rivers produced no available partners, making the search for the mineral route somewhat frustrating.

surprise.text: The vent had no available combinations despite its description mentioning dissolved chemicals, so the mineral goal required a separate route.

arbitrary.text: Rainfall could weather the continent but not the stone crust; that distinction was not clear to me when I tried it.

continue.text: Yes. The geological explanations and the eventual connection between weathering, rivers and the sea made me curious to see what comes next, despite a few dead ends.
